requirements.text: The system must meter every billable API call per customer account with an idempotency key.
details: If the same idempotency key is received twice, then usage is counted once.

requirements.text: The system must aggregate metered usage into hourly totals per account and price dimension.
details: When an hour closes, then its totals are final within 15 minutes.

requirements.text: Billing admins can view current-period usage and projected charges on the billing page. Depends on FR-2.
details: Projected charges use the trailing 7-day average and are labelled as an estimate.

requirements.text: The system must generate a monthly invoice that itemises seat charges and usage charges. Depends on FR-2.
Billing admins can set a monthly spend alert threshold and receive an email when 80% and 100% are reached.
details: When usage crosses a threshold, then exactly one alert email is sent per threshold per period.

requirements.text: Developers can query usage for their account through a usage API endpoint.
Finance analysts can export monthly usage and invoice lines as CSV for reconciliation. Depends on FR-4.
Billing admins can download past invoices as PDF.
Usage ingestion must sustain 5,000 events per second with p99 write latency under 50 ms.
Invoices must reconcile to metered usage with zero unexplained difference at month close.
Pricing changes must be versioned so past invoices can be regenerated exactly.

epics.title: Usage-Based Billing
epics.description: We currently bill a flat monthly price per seat. Customers running large API workloads pay the same as light users, and finance cannot price heavy usage. This PRD introduces metered billing for API calls on top of the seat price.

risks.description: Metering bugs directly cause over- or under-billing and erode customer trust.
Customers may react badly to bill increases without warning.
Unresolved question: Do we offer a free usage tier per plan, and how large?
risks.mitigation: Resolve with the PRD owner before the related stories enter a sprint.

risks.description: External dependency: The payments provider integration must support adding usage line items to invoices.
risks.mitigation: Confirm scope and timeline with the owning team before committing dependents.
